chapter.v:
The Lord
told Moses,

“Put up
the Tabernacle, the Tent of Meeting, on the first day of the first month of the year.

Place the
Ark of the Testimony inside it. Make sure the Ark is behind the veil.

Bring in
the table and put on it what's necessary. Bring in the lampstand too, and set up its lamps.

Place the
gold altar of incense in front of the Ark of the Testimony, and put up the screen at the entrance to the Tabernacle.

Set up
the altar of burnt offering opposite the entrance to the Tabernacle, the Tent of Meeting.

Place the
basin between the Tent of Meeting and the altar, and put water in it.

Set up
the courtyard that's around it, and put up the curtain for the courtyard entrance.

Use the
anointing oil to anoint the Tabernacle and everything in it. Dedicate it and all its furniture to make it holy.

Anoint the
altar of burnt offering and all its utensils. Dedicate the altar and it will be especially holy.

Anoint and
dedicate the basin with its stand.

Take Aaron
and his sons to the entrance of the Tent of Meeting and wash them there with water.

Then you
are to put on Aaron the holy clothes, anoint him, and dedicate him, so that he may serve me as a priest.

Have his
sons come forward and dress them with tunics.

Anoint them
in the same way as you anointed their father, so that they can also serve me as priests. Their anointing makes their line priests forever, for generations to come.”

Moses carried
out all the Lord's instructions.

The Tabernacle
was put up on the first day of the first month of the second year.

When Moses
put up the Tabernacle, he placed its stands, attached its frames, connected its crossbars, and erected its posts.

Then he
spread the tent over the Tabernacle and placed the covering over the tent, as the Lord had ordered him to do.

Moses took
the Testimony and put it in the Ark. He attached the poles to the Ark, and he placed the atonement cover on the top of the Ark.

Then he
carried the Ark into the Tabernacle. He put up the veil, and made sure the Ark of the Testimony was behind it, as the Lord had ordered him to do.

Moses placed
the table inside the Tent of Meeting on the north side of the Tabernacle, outside the veil.

He laid
out the bread on it in the presence of the Lord, as the Lord had ordered him to do.

He placed
the lampstand in the Tent of Meeting opposite the table on the south side of the Tabernacle

and put
up the lamps in the presence of the Lord, as the Lord had ordered him to do.

Moses set
up the gold altar in the Tent of Meeting, in front of the veil,

and he
burned aromatic incense on it, as the Lord had ordered him to do.

Then he
put up the screen at the entrance to the Tabernacle.

He set
up the altar of burnt offering near the entrance to the Tabernacle, the Tent of Meeting, and presented the burnt offering and the grain offering, as the Lord had ordered him to do.

He placed
the basin between the Tent of Meeting and the altar and put water in it for washing.

Moses, Aaron,
and his sons used it to wash their hands and feet

They washed
whenever they went into the Tent of Meeting or approached the altar, as the Lord had ordered Moses to do.

Moses set
up the courtyard around the Tabernacle and the altar, and he put up the curtain for the courtyard entrance. This marked the end of the work done by Moses.

Then the
cloud covered the Tent of Meeting, and the glory of the Lord filled the Tabernacle.

Moses could
not enter the Tent of Meeting because the cloud remained on it, and the glory of the Lord filled the Tabernacle.

Whenever the
cloud rose from the Tabernacle, the Israelites would set off again on their journey.

If the
cloud did not rise, they wouldn't set out until it did.

The cloud
of the Lord stayed over the Tabernacle by day, and fire burned inside the cloud by night, so that it could be seen by every Israelite wherever they traveled.
